definitions.explanation: Extremely steep and rising sharply, typically describing mountains, cliffs, slopes, or terrain.

examples.japanese: {急峻|きゅうしゅん}な⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}った→登る：00660_noboru⟧。
examples.english: We climbed a steep mountain path.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{急峻|きゅうしゅん}な⟦{地形|ちけい}→地形：12083_chikei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This area has a lot of steep terrain.

examples.japanese: {急峻|きゅうしゅん}な⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧そびえ{立|た}ち、⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すくんだ→すくむ：10356_sukumu⟧。
examples.english: A sheer cliff towered above, and looking down made my legs freeze.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧ (steep/sudden) and {峻|しゅん} (towering/precipitous). Describes terrain that is not merely steep but dramatically so — nearly vertical cliffs, extremely steep mountain faces, or rugged highland terrain. More literary and emphatic than the common ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急峻|きゅうしゅん}な⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧: steep mountain
- {急峻|きゅうしゅん}な⟦{斜面|しゃめん}→斜面：12870_shamen⟧: steep slope
- {急峻|きゅうしゅん}な⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧: sheer cliff
- {急峻|きゅうしゅん}な⟦{地形|ちけい}→地形：12083_chikei⟧: rugged terrain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{険|けわ}しい→険しい：08154_kewashii⟧: steep, rugged — the most common everyday word for steep terrain
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な: steep, sudden — general-purpose, less dramatic
- {切|き}り{立|た}った: sheer, precipitous — describes a cliff that drops straight down
- {峻険|しゅんけん}: steep and rugged — literary synonym, nearly interchangeable
